nodes.summary: A real sequence $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is asymptotically convergent to a real number $S$ when there is an index sequence $s$ of density one such that $x_{s(n)} \to S$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Asymptotically convergent sequences

nodes.summary: A sequence $s \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ has density one when it is strictly increasing and $s(n+1)/(n+1) \to 1$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Index sequences of density one

nodes.summary: A real sequence $(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is bounded when there is a real number $B$ with $|x_n| \le B$ for all $n$.
nodes.title: Bounded sequences

nodes.summary: A real matrix $(a_{ik})_{i,k \in \mathbb{N}}$ is a permanent (regular, or Toeplitz) method when it sums every convergent real sequence to its limit: for every real sequence $x$ and real number $S$ with $x_n \to S$, the matrix sums $x$ to $S$.
nodes.title: Permanent matrix methods

nodes.summary: A real matrix $(a_{ik})_{i,k \in \mathbb{N}}$ sums a real sequence $(x_k)_{k \in \mathbb{N}}$ to a real number $S$ when for every row $i$ the series $\sum_k a_{ik} x_k$ converges unconditionally (equivalently, absolutely) and the row sums $\sum_k a_{ik} x_k$ tend to $S$ as $i \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Summation by a matrix method

nodes.summary: There is no real matrix $(a_{ik})_{i,k \in \mathbb{N}}$ that is a permanent matrix method such that for every bounded real sequence $x$ and every real number $S$, the matrix sums $x$ to $S$ if and only if $x$ is asymptotically convergent to $S$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to Scottish Book Problem 5 for bounded sequences

nodes.summary: There is a real matrix $(a_{ik})_{i,k \in \mathbb{N}}$ that is a permanent matrix method such that for every bounded real sequence $x$ and every real number $S$, the matrix sums $x$ to $S$ if and only if $x$ is asymptotically convergent to $S$.
nodes.title: The bounded case of Scottish Book Problem 5

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
